prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: best AI video ad maker depends on your use case
answer_verbatim:
The **best AI video ad maker depends on your use case**, but for most marketers the strongest all-around picks in the results are **HeyFish**, **HeyGen**, and **Revid.ai**. HeyFish is presented as the “best overall” AI video ad maker for most marketers, while HeyGen is ranked first for ad generation in one independent review, and Revid.ai is the top choice for short-form paid social workflows.[1][2][15]

- **Best overall for most marketers:** **HeyFish** — cited as the best overall AI video ad maker, with 1,500+ AI actors, product-holding capability, URL-to-video automation, and templates for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.[1]
- **Best for avatar-driven, multilingual ads:** **HeyGen** — ranked first in testing for avatar quality, multilingual reach, and automated ad creation through Video Agent.[2]
- **Best for short-form paid social and UGC-style workflows:** **Revid.ai** — described as the best overall AI video editor for ads, especially for product-page-to-ad, captions, hooks, and multi-variant testing.[15]

If you want a single recommendation, **HeyFish** is the best “general” answer from these results because it is explicitly positioned as best overall and is also the most budget-friendly among the top recommendations cited.[1] If your priority is **multilingual avatar ads**, choose **HeyGen**; if your priority is **short-form performance ads**, choose **Revid.ai**.[2][15]
